<!-- Worth knowing before you write: Vantage is deliberately small. It shows yesterday's proceeds
     and downloads in the menu bar. Full charting, reviews and ratings, and anything that sends data
     to a third party are out of scope — see CONTRIBUTING.md.

     One thing that will always be declined: estimating today's sales. Apple publishes daily reports
     the next morning and offers no API for today. Extrapolating and showing the result as a number
     is the thing this app exists not to do. -->
